edges.sentence: Our architecture does this by combining several techniques in a novel way: (1) Unlike the shallow NN used in many 1990s applications, ours are deep, inspired by the Neocognitron [Fukushima 1980], with many (6-10) layers of non-linear neurons stacked on top of each other, comparable to the number of layers found between retina and visual cortex of macaque monkeys [Bichot et al. 2005]. (2) It was shown [Hochreiter et al. 2001] that such multi-layered DNN are hard to train by standard gradient descent [Werbos 1974; LeCun 1985; Rumelhart et al. 1986], the method of choice from a mathematical/algorithmic point of view.
edges.title: Neocognitron: A self-organizing neural network for a mechanism of pattern recognition unaffected by shift in position
